name: What should I prepare before my initial kitchen remodel consultation?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before my initial kitchen remodel consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting with a remodeling contractor, gather rough room dimensions, inspirational photos, appliance preferences, and a realistic investment range. Note existing frustrations with your current setup, such as inadequate pantry storage, poor lighting, or crowded walkways. It also helps to list which appliances you intend to reuse versus replace, as equipment dimensions dictate cabinet drawings. Having clear priorities regarding materials, such as quartz versus granite or painted versus stained wood, enables your contractor to provide accurate initial estimates and design guidance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather inspirational photos, list current layout issues, note appliance preferences or dimensions, and define your target budget range to guide the initial consultation.
